summary: Verified end-to-end that the reported 'admin login stops working after deploy' bug is FIXED. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed — admin_users seeded in Mongo with bcrypt $2b$ hash; /api/admin/login OK; wrong password returns 401 with 'Email atau password salah'; /api/admin/me works with token; token PERSISTS across `supervisorctl restart backend` (session stored in admin_sessions collection, no longer in-memory); /api/auth/me without cookie returns 401 (Google Auth intact); POST /api/admin/users creates buyer user with bcrypt hash; POST /api/auth/login with new credentials returns 200, sets httpOnly session_token cookie, /api/auth/me returns user; wrong password returns 401; Article CRUD full lifecycle works (POST/GET/PUT/DELETE via admin API, and public GET /api/articles reflects created article and removes it after delete). Frontend: /login page renders google-login-button + pw-login-email/password/submit; password login via UI navigates to /akun successfully. Admin dashboard: admin-tab-articles opens, article-add-btn opens modal with 12 form fields, article-form-submit visible. /berita hydrates live from GET /api/articles (verified by seeding a live article and finding its title on the page). /cari-properti: Filter Lokasi button confirmed at x=690, first location tab at x=811 → button is LEFT of tabs. NOTE: my UI test-script Excerpt field selector didn't match the modal's actual input (likely uses a different placeholder text); backend CRUD is confirmed working, so this is a test-script issue rather than a product bug.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.seed_admin is correctly idempotent — creates if missing, re-syncs password_hash when env changes.

Admin sessions are now DB-backed (admin_sessions collection) with expires_at TTL of 7d; requires periodic cleanup or a TTL index — consider adding db.admin_sessions.create_index('expires_at', expireAfterSeconds=0).
user_routes.auth_login uses secrets.token_urlsafe(32) for session_token and correctly sets httpOnly+secure+SameSite=None cookie — cross-site iframe-safe.
LoginPage.jsx uses withCredentials:true for password login, matches CORS(allow_credentials=True) config.
ArticleForm modal fields are functional (article-add-btn opens modal with 12 inputs and article-form-submit button).
